lines.en: label bar45:
scene sanayukitrain1
I decide to spend the night hanging out at the bar with Sana.
lines.zh: 我决定今晚就待在酒吧里陪 Sana。

lines.en: : You...didn’t really pick the best night to...hang out here...
lines.zh: : 你……今晚挑的日子……真不太适合来这儿待着……

lines.en: scene black
I go home because Sana hates me.
lines.zh: 我回家了，因为 Sana 讨厌我。

lines.en: scene sanayukitrain1
: Sana, I don’t really think you should be picking and choosing your customers when your mother’s store is about to go under.
lines.zh: : Sana，你妈的店都快倒闭了，我觉得你实在不该挑客人。

lines.en: : I...don’t really have much to pick and choose from either way...
lines.zh: : 反正……我也没什么好挑的……

lines.en: : I just meant that...I might be a little busier than normal tonight...
lines.zh: : 我的意思是……今晚我可能比平时忙一点……

lines.en: : Oh? Did someone accidentally book a birthday party here thinking it was some other bar?
lines.zh: : 哦？是有人把这儿当成别的酒吧，误订了生日派对？

lines.en: scene sanayukitrain2
: It’s just that...our new employee is here tonight and...I have to show her how to make drinks...
lines.zh: : 只是……我们新来的员工今晚在，我得……教她怎么调酒……

lines.en: : How many customers do you actually have to make drinks for?
lines.zh: : 你们到底有多少客人需要调酒？

lines.en: : Because the friendly neighborhood lesbian couple and myself are the only people who seem to come here and all three of us just get beer.
lines.zh: : 因为常来的好像就只有那对亲切的邻家女同情侣和我，而且我们三个都只喝啤酒。

lines.en: : Well...we don’t really...ever make them, but...it’s an important thing for a bartender to know...
lines.zh: : 嗯……我们其实……从来没调过，可……对调酒师来说，这是很重要的本事……

lines.en: : Well, good luck. I can’t imagine your new employee is very easy to train.
lines.zh: : 行吧，祝你好运。我猜你那位新员工可不好带。

lines.en: : Hey. You talkin’ shit over there?
lines.zh: : 喂。你在那儿说我坏话呢？

lines.en: scene sanayukitrain3
: Please don’t hit me.
lines.zh: : 别打我，求你了。

lines.en: : You think I’d actually hit you while I'm workin’?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我会上着班动手？

lines.en: : No. But I’m afraid you’d follow me home and beat me up on the way there.
lines.zh: : 不会。但我怕你会一路跟到我家里，在路上把我揍一顿。

lines.en: scene sanayukitrain4
: Hah...not worth the effort...
lines.zh: : 哈……不值当费那个劲……

lines.en: : Just havin’ a job is tiring enough.
lines.zh: : 光是有份工作就已经够累的了。

lines.en: : Yuki...you’ve only been working for...half an hour...
lines.zh: : Yuki……你才刚上了……半个钟头的班……

lines.en: : Jesus, is that all? I feel like I’ve been here all night.
lines.zh: : 靠，才这么点时间？我都感觉自己在这儿待了一整晚了。

lines.en: : No wonder Yumi started her own business.
lines.zh: : 难怪 Yumi 自己去创业了。

lines.en: : Again, she...
lines.zh: : 再说一遍，她……

lines.en: : Ah, fuck it. Sure.
lines.zh: : 啊，算了。随你吧。

lines.en: I resign myself to the concept of Yumi Yamaguchi being a successful entrepreneur and allow Yuki to believe whatever it is her shriveled heart desires.
lines.zh: 我认了——Yumi Yamaguchi 就是个成功的企业家——随 Yuki 那颗干瘪的心想信什么就信什么吧。

lines.en: scene sanayukitrain5
: So, now what? What’s step two in becoming a successful barmaid or whatever?
lines.zh: : 那现在干嘛？当一个成功的酒吧女招待什么的，第二步是什么？

lines.en: : Um...well...you can start by...taking Sensei’s order...
lines.zh: : 嗯……那个……你可以先从……帮 Sensei 点单开始……

lines.en: scene sanayukitrain6
: Cool. What do you want?
lines.zh: : 行。你想要什么？

lines.en: : Sensei...for the sake of...Yuki’s training...can you order something different from what you usually order?...
lines.zh: : Sensei……为了……Yuki 的训练……你能不能点个跟平时不一样的？……

lines.en: : Uhhhh...
: I’ll take...a Manhattan?
lines.zh: : 那我要一杯……曼哈顿？

lines.en: : A Manhattan? Are you a fucking prissy boy?
lines.zh: : 曼哈顿？你他妈的是个矫情小子吗？

lines.en: : There’s a perfectly good beer in front of you. Drink that.
lines.zh: : 你面前就摆着好好的啤酒。喝那个。

lines.en: scene sanayukitrain7
: Y...Yuki! You can’t...talk to customers that way!
lines.zh: : Y……Yuki！你不能……那样跟客人说话！

lines.en: : Really?
lines.zh: : 是吗？

lines.en: : But I thought your mom said to play up my “rough exterior” or whatever it is she thought would bring new people in.
lines.zh: : 可我以为你妈说过，要我把“粗犷的外表”发挥出来什么的，说这样能招来新客人。

lines.en: : It’s okay to be mean to Sensei normally-
lines.zh: : 平时对 Sensei 凶一点没关系——

lines.en: : Wait, it is?
lines.zh: : 等等，没关系吗？

lines.en: : But for right now...you have to look at Sensei like...not Sensei...and...and treat him like a normal person...
lines.zh: : 但现在……你得把 Sensei 当成……不是 Sensei……然后……把他当普通人对待……

lines.en: scene sanayukitrain8
: You want me to treat {i}this guy{/i} like a normal customer? Dude’s far from normal if he’s comin’ here to chat with a four foot tall [teenager].
lines.zh: : 你要我把{i}这家伙{/i}当普通客人？一个大老远跑来跟个四英尺高的[teenager]聊天的家伙，可一点都不普通。

lines.en: : I take great offense to this entire exchange. I just want to drink.
lines.zh: : 你们这段对话让我非常不爽。我只是想喝杯酒。

lines.en: : Where is Sara? I need to speak to the owner.
lines.zh: : Sara 在哪儿？我要找老板说话。

lines.en: : She’s...in the urban district, passing out fliers right now...
lines.zh: : 她……现在在商业区发传单……

lines.en: scene sanayukitrain9
: Also...I’m...almost five feet tall...
lines.zh: : 还有……我……快到五英尺了……

lines.en: : Same shit.
lines.zh: : 都一个样。

lines.en: : But if we’ve gotta do this the normal way...what are you drinking, bud?
lines.zh: : 不过既然得按正常流程来……哥们儿，你喝什么？

lines.en: : Bud?
lines.zh: : 哥们儿？

lines.en: : What're you ordering, pal?
lines.zh: : 兄弟，你点什么？

lines.en: : Why do I need a weird nickname?
lines.zh: : 我为什么非得有个奇怪的绰号？

lines.en: : What’re you havin’, champ?
lines.zh: : 冠军，来点什么？

lines.en: : How about “master” or “my prince?”
lines.zh: : 叫“主人”或者“我的王子”怎么样？

lines.en: : How about you suck my fucking dick and order your stupid ass Manhattan already?
lines.zh: : 要不你他妈的先给我含住，再把你那杯破曼哈顿点了？

lines.en: scene sanayukitrain10
: Well, when you put it that way- one Manhattan, please.
lines.zh: : 行吧，你都这么说了——那就来一杯曼哈顿，谢谢。

lines.en: : Hah...this is...proving to be even harder than I thought it would be...
lines.zh: : 哈……这……比我预想的还要难……

lines.en: : Comin’ right up.
lines.zh: : 马上就来。

lines.en: scene sanayukitrain11
: So, now what?
lines.zh: : 那现在呢？

lines.en: : You’re the genius bartender girl and I don’t have any idea what the fuck goes into a Manhattan.
lines.zh: : 你才是那个天才调酒师小姑娘，我他妈的压根不知道曼哈顿里都放什么。

lines.en: : Well...the ingredients for a Manhattan are...bourbon...orange and Angostura bitters...and...um...sweet vermouth...
lines.zh: : 嗯……曼哈顿的原料是……波本威士忌……橙味和安高天娜苦精……还有……嗯……甜味美思……

lines.en: : I love sweet vermouth.
lines.zh: : 我最喜欢甜味美思了。

lines.en: : And...it’s...garnished with a brandied cherry on top...
lines.zh: : 还有……最后要……用一颗酒渍樱桃做装饰……

lines.en: scene sanayukitrain12
: So...um...you’ll want to add the bourbon, vermouth and bitters to a mixing glass with ice and...stir it until it’s chilled...
lines.zh: : 那么……嗯……你要把波本、味美思和苦精倒进加了冰的调酒杯里……搅拌到冷却……

lines.en: : Then you just...strain it into a glass and...add the garnish...
lines.zh: : 然后就……滤进杯子里……加上装饰……

lines.en: : And then it’s done...
lines.zh: : 这样就完成了……

lines.en: : Got it. Now, where can I find all that stuff?
lines.zh: : 懂了。那这些东西都在哪儿？

lines.en: : We...don’t have any in stock right now...
lines.zh: : 我们……现在没有存货……

lines.en: : Your mom's gonna need a lot of fuckin' fliers.
lines.zh: : 你妈得印他妈的一大堆传单才行。

lines.en: scene black
Sana goes over the ingredients to a bunch of popular cocktails that the bar is currently incapable of making and I imagine that Yuki forgets all of them instantaneously.
lines.zh: Sana 把一堆当下酒吧做不出来的热门鸡尾酒的配方过了一遍，我猜 Yuki 转头就全忘了。

lines.en: I’m a little surprised to see that Sana has everything memorized, though. Especially when no one ever orders anything like that here.
lines.zh: 不过 Sana 居然把这些全都背下来了，我有点意外。尤其这儿根本没人点过那种东西。

lines.en: But I guess things haven’t always been like that at the bar.
lines.zh: 不过我想，这家酒吧也不一直是这样的。

lines.en: If I’m remembering correctly, the place has been in Sana and Sara’s family for a while now and was actually relatively popular before the space war.
lines.zh: 如果我没记错的话，这家店在 Sana 和 Sara 家手里已经传了一阵子了，在太空战争之前其实还挺有人气的。

lines.en: It kind of sucks that everything went downhill after that, but...maybe there really {i}is{/i} a chance for them to turn things around?
lines.zh: 之后就一路走下坡，挺可惜的，不过……也许她们真的{i}有{/i}机会翻身？

lines.en: Though...I imagine that will be pretty hard without actual ingredients.
lines.zh: 不过……没有原料的话，我想这事儿会很难。

lines.en: Anyway, Sana winds up sending Yuki home after another hour of training and pulls a few bills out of their register to pay her for the night.
lines.zh: 总之，又培训了一个钟头后，Sana 打发 Yuki 回家，从收银机里抽出几张钞票当她今晚的工钱。

lines.en: I notice that it’s nowhere near the amount that she’s likely owed, but...I don’t think Yuki’s really in the position to ask for more with zero work experience in her late thirties.
lines.zh: 我注意到这数目跟她应得的差得远，不过……一个快四十、工作经验为零的人，我想 Yuki 也没什么立场要求更多。

lines.en: I also doubt that she’s even familiar with what minimum wage is.
lines.zh: 我还怀疑她压根不知道什么叫最低工资。

lines.en: But regardless, she accepts the money and exits the bar...leaving Sana and I alone once again.
lines.zh: 不管怎么说，她收下钱走了……又只剩 Sana 和我两个人。

lines.en: scene sanayukitrain13
: I...um...I’m sorry you...couldn’t get the Manhattan you ordered...
lines.zh: : 我……嗯……对不起，你……没喝上你点的曼哈顿……

lines.en: : I never would have ordered that if I wasn’t asked to order something...fancier.
lines.zh: : 要不是你让我点个……高级点的，我根本不会点那个。

lines.en: : Frankly, I didn’t even remember what a Manhattan was. It’s just the first cocktail that came to mind.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我连曼哈顿是什么都不记得了。只是脑子里冒出来的第一种鸡尾酒。

lines.en: : Also, you should probably restock the bar some day.
lines.zh: : 还有，你们哪天该补补货了。

lines.en: scene sanayukitrain14
: I agree...and...so does my mom...
lines.zh: : 我同意……我妈……也同意……

lines.en: : There just...hasn’t really been any reason to with our current...clientele.
lines.zh: : 只是……以我们现在的……客人构成，实在没什么必要……

lines.en: : Is Sara really passing out fliers in the urban district right now?
lines.zh: : Sara 现在真的在商业区发传单？

lines.en: scene sanayukitrain15
: Mhm. It’s the first time in a while that I’ve seen her go out of her way to try and bring people in.
lines.zh: : 嗯。我很久没见她这么卖力地想把客人拉进来了。

lines.en: : So...I’m doing my part and training our new employee while she’s out doing that.
lines.zh: : 所以……我也在尽我的一份力，趁她出去的时候培训我们的新员工。

lines.en: : Speaking of which, you handled Yuki surprisingly well.
lines.zh: : 说到这个，你把 Yuki 应付得意外地好。

lines.en: : I figured that she was the exact type of person who’d cause you to cower in fear by simply looking at her.
lines.zh: : 我本来以为，她就是那种光看你一眼就能把你吓得缩成一团的人。

lines.en: scene sanayukitrain16
: If she was in her normal clothes...I probably would have been a lot more scared...
lines.zh: : 要是她穿着平时的衣服……我大概会怕得多……

lines.en: : It was just a little easier since...we were dressed in pretty much the same outfit...
lines.zh: : 因为……我们穿得差不多是一样的制服，所以稍微好一点……

lines.en: : And...I think it’s also because...I might...kind of be getting used to people now...
lines.zh: : 而且……我想还因为……我可能……渐渐习惯跟人相处了……

lines.en: : Well you’ve certainly increased your friend count by a sizable margin.
lines.zh: : 你的朋友数量确实涨了不少。

lines.en: scene sanayukitrain17
: Heheh...yeah...
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……是啊……

lines.en: : I was...even able to sleep over your house without Ayane recently...
lines.zh: : 我前不久……甚至能在没有 Ayane 陪的情况下，在你家过夜了……

lines.en: : Yeah. I was kind of surprised about that-
lines.zh: : 是啊。我还挺意外的——

lines.en: Wait...
lines.zh: 等等……

lines.en: I thought the last reset made it so that sleepover never happened?
lines.zh: 上一次重置不是把那次留宿抹掉了吗？

lines.en: At least that’s what Ayane said and...Sana {i}was{/i} at the dorm when I got back from the rooftop.
lines.zh: 至少 Ayane 是这么说的，而且……我从天台回来的时候，Sana {i}确实{/i}在宿舍里。

lines.en: scene sanayukitrain18
: Um...Sensei?...
lines.zh: : 嗯……Sensei？……

lines.en: : Is...there a reason you’re just...staring at me?
lines.zh: : 你……为什么一直……盯着我看？

lines.en: : When did you sleep over my house without Ayane?
lines.zh: : 你什么时候在我家过夜，而 Ayane 不在的？

lines.en: scene sanayukitrain19
: Um...it was...recently, wasn’t it?
lines.zh: : 嗯……就是……最近吧？

lines.en: : For me, yes. But Ayane was under the impression that it never even happened.
lines.zh: : 对我来说是最近。可 Ayane 觉得那件事根本没发生过。

lines.en: : That’s...weird. I could have sworn I talked to her about it...
lines.zh: : 这……好奇怪。我明明记得我跟她聊过这件事……

lines.en: : And I...still remember the dinner that...Tsuneyo made for us...
lines.zh: : 而且我……还记得 Tsuneyo 给我们做的那顿晚饭……

lines.en: : But...um...
: There’s...something else I kind of wanted to say as long as we’re done talking about that...
lines.zh: : 既然这个聊完了……我……还有点别的话想说……

lines.en: : Is that...okay?
lines.zh: : 可以……吗？

lines.en: scene sanayukitrain20
: Yeah.
: Sorry for getting distracted. Time is just kind of weird sometimes.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，我走神了。时间这东西有时候就是很怪。

lines.en: : Yeah...
lines.zh: : 是啊……

lines.en: : It’s crazy how...quickly it can go by when you stop paying attention...
lines.zh: : 真不可思议……你要是不去留意，它就过得飞快……

lines.en: : But...the time we’ve spent together...if anything...has seemed kind of slow for me...
lines.zh: : 可是……我们在一起的时间……要说的话……对我来说反而有点慢……

lines.en: : Which is weird because...it also feels like so much has happened...
lines.zh: : 这很奇怪，因为……同时又觉得发生了好多事……

lines.en: : And if it weren’t for you, I...probably wouldn’t be able to do stuff like...train really intimidating employees or...sleep places I’ve never slept before.
lines.zh: : 如果没有你，我……大概也没法做到这些……比如培训很吓人的员工，或者……睡在从没睡过的地方。

lines.en: : Congratulations on the character growth.
lines.zh: : 恭喜你角色成长了。

lines.en: : Hehe...that’s a good way of putting it...
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……这个说法不错……

lines.en: : My mom...didn’t put any of my stat points into speech, so...I’ve been kind of...soft locked progression-wise for a little while.
lines.zh: : 我妈……没把任何属性点加在“口才”上，所以……我在成长这方面……卡关有一阵子了。

lines.en: : But...now I’ve got...another party member who...can help me train in that field...
lines.zh: : 不过……现在我有了……另一个能帮我练这项的……队友……

lines.en: : I think you’ve been spending a little too much time with Molly.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你跟 Molly 待太久了。

lines.en: scene sanayukitrain21
: Probably...but...spending time with other people isn’t really always a bad thing...
lines.zh: : 大概是吧……不过……跟别人待在一起也不总是坏事……

lines.en: : I know that now.
lines.zh: : 我现在知道了。

lines.en: : Not that I...ever thought it {i}was{/i} bad. It just seemed kind of hard.
lines.zh: : 倒不是说我……以前觉得那{i}很{/i}糟。只是看起来挺难的。

lines.en: : Well, you still have the rest of the class to work up to befriending. And I want to warn you now that if you think getting closer to Yuki will help win over Yumi, it most certainly will not.
lines.zh: : 嗯，班里其他人你还得一个个去交。我先把话放这儿：你要是以为跟 Yuki 搞好关系就能拿下 Yumi，那绝对不可能。

lines.en: scene sanayukitrain22
: Yeah...I already heard about that...
lines.zh: : 嗯……这事我听说了……

lines.en: : Yumi is...not really near the top of my...potential friends list right now...
lines.zh: : Yumi 现在……在我“潜在朋友清单”上的排名……真不靠前……

lines.en: : She’s still...really scary...
lines.zh: : 她还是……很吓人……

lines.en: : But...
lines.zh: : 不过……

lines.en: : I don’t think it’s impossible anymore.
lines.zh: : 我不再觉得那是不可能的了。

lines.en: : In fact...I’m starting to think that there isn’t really anything that’s impossible.
lines.zh: : 事实上……我开始觉得，其实没什么事是不可能的。

lines.en: : I don’t know how you did it, but...you kind of just walked into my life and opened up a bunch of doors that I...didn’t think I’d ever be able to open.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你是怎么做到的，可是……你就那么走进了我的生活，替我打开了一扇又一扇……我以为自己永远打不开的门。

lines.en: : Were the handles too high up?
lines.zh: : 是因为门把手太高了吗？

lines.en: scene sanayukitrain23
: Is everyone going to pick on my size tonight or something?
lines.zh: : 今晚大家是约好了要拿我的身高开涮还是怎么着？

lines.en: : Hey. I, for one, appreciate how small you are.
lines.zh: : 嘿。至少我本人，很欣赏你的娇小。

lines.en: : I want you to stay this size forever.
lines.zh: : 我希望你永远保持这个尺寸。

lines.en: scene sanayukitrain24
: You do?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: scene sanayukitrain25
: No reason.
lines.zh: : 没什么理由。

lines.en: : I...highly doubt that...but I’m going to...go ahead and assume you're just joking...
lines.zh: : 我……非常怀疑这一点……不过我……还是先当你是在开玩笑吧……

lines.en: : I might be growing as a person, but...I also think I shouldn't really count on growing any more as a {i}person.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我作为一个人也许在成长，但……我觉得作为一{i}个人{/i}，我不该指望自己还能再长了……

lines.en: : My mom is...really small for her age, too...so I doubt I have many inches left.
lines.zh: : 我妈……在她那个年纪里也算很矮的……所以我估计我也没几英寸可长了。

lines.en: : Don’t worry. I’ll let you borrow several of mine as soon as you’re ready.
lines.zh: : 别担心。等你准备好了，我匀几英寸给你。

lines.en: : I...don’t really think that’s how height works...
lines.zh: : 我……觉得身高不是这么算的吧……

lines.en: Even if Sana does wind up growing a little more, I hope her level of wholesomeness stays about the same.
lines.zh: 就算 Sana 真的还能再长一点，我希望她这份纯真还能保持原样。

lines.en: I don’t want to think about a time where I can say things like that and have her immediately comprehend the unreal amount of ulterior motives I have.
lines.zh: 我可不想有一天，我说出那种话，她立刻就能看穿我背后那多得离谱的心思。

lines.en: : Anyway, I’m proud of you or whatever.
lines.zh: : 总之，我为你感到骄傲什么的。

lines.en: scene sanayukitrain26
: Or whatever?...
lines.zh: : 什么的？……

lines.en: : Fine. I’m proud of you, okay?
lines.zh: : 好吧。我为你感到骄傲，行了吧？

lines.en: : I thought it would take a lot longer for you to stop acting like a scared little bunny rabbit- and that you’d wind up leaning on me a little more than you actually had to.
lines.zh: : 我本来以为，你要花更久才能不像只受惊的小兔子——而且你会比我预想的更依赖我。

lines.en: : That’s funny, cause...all this time...I felt like I might have been leaning on you a little too much...
lines.zh: : 真有意思，因为……一直以来……我都觉得自己可能太依赖你了……

lines.en: : Ayane, too.
lines.zh: : Ayane 也是。

lines.en: : Both of you believed in me when...I had trouble believing in myself...
lines.zh: : 在我……没法相信自己的时候，你们两个都相信我……

lines.en: scene sanayukitrain27
: And I...don’t want to agree that I’m a...bunny or anything...
lines.zh: : 而且我……不想承认自己是只……兔子什么的……

lines.en: : But I’d like it if...I could still maybe...lean on you a little bit once I start having to...do harder things...
lines.zh: : 不过我希望……等我以后要面对……更难的事时，还能……稍微依赖你一点……

lines.en: : Like...ordering food over the phone or...making a withdrawal at the bank...
lines.zh: : 比如……打电话点外卖，或者……去银行取钱……

lines.en: : Just use an ATM. No one actually goes inside of banks anymore unless it’s something really important.
lines.zh: : 用自动取款机就行了。现在除非是很重要的事，没人真的会走进银行里面。

lines.en: scene sanayukitrain28
: It was just an example, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我只是举个例子啦，Sensei。

lines.en: : What I mean is that...just because I’m doing a little better doesn’t mean I don’t still need you.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是……就算我好一点了，也不代表我不需要你了。

lines.en: : Well, thanks. But, just to remind you, I’m a highly sought after individual and it might not always be as easy as this to get my attention.
lines.zh: : 嗯，谢谢。不过我得提醒你，我可是个很抢手的人，想引起我的注意，未必总能像现在这么容易。

lines.en: : Is that...the next phase of my training? Having to...force you to spend time with me so others can’t?
lines.zh: : 那……这是我训练的下一阶段吗？得……逼你跟我待在一起，好让别人抢不走？

lines.en: : Maybe not the {i}next{/i} step, but it feels like that one is definitely on the way to whatever your final goal may be.
lines.zh: : 也许不是{i}下一{/i}步，但不管你的最终目标是什么，这一步肯定在路上。

lines.en: : I need a final goal? I can’t just...enjoy my time with you and everyone else?
lines.zh: : 我非得有个最终目标吗？我就不能……单纯享受和你还有大家在一起的时光？

lines.en: : Sure you can.
lines.zh: : 当然可以。

lines.en: : I just don’t think complacency is really as fulfilling as you’re making it sound.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得，安于现状并不像你说得那么让人满足。

lines.en: : But...isn’t that exactly how you live {i}your{/i} life, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 可是……Sensei，你不就是这样过{i}你{/i}的日子的吗？

lines.en: : I thought you just...wanted things to stay the way they are now...
lines.zh: : 我以为你只是……希望一切保持现在这样……
: 还是说……

lines.en: : Or do you maybe...have something you actually want?...
lines.zh: : 还是说你其实……有什么真正想要的东西？……

lines.en: scene black
The two of us sit there in silence for a little while longer as I attempt to think of all of the things I want.
lines.zh: 我们两个又沉默地坐了一会儿，我试着去想自己想要的那些东西。

lines.en: Within a matter of moments, I find myself stranded on a desert island filled with blurry thoughts and the idea that there {i}are{/i} things that I want.
lines.zh: 没过多久，我发现自己被困在一座荒岛上，岛上满是模糊的念头，还有“我{i}确实{/i}有想要的东西”这个想法。

lines.en: So many of them that I feel surrounded.
lines.zh: 多到我感觉自己被它们包围了。

lines.en: But they lurk in the shadows of large trees-
lines.zh: 可它们躲在大树的阴影里——

lines.en: And I can’t make out what they look like.
lines.zh: 我看不清它们长什么样。

lines.en: So I decide they aren’t there at all.
lines.zh: 于是我断定它们根本不存在。

lines.en: And I go to sleep in a shelter someone else built and abandoned.
lines.zh: 然后我在一个别人搭好又弃之不用的庇护所里睡着了。

lines.en: I leave the bar.
lines.zh: 我离开了酒吧。
